pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:0.6: ime kho panāyyāyo sekhiyādhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambenti nivāsenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsessanti, seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyo”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khiyyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.7: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambenti nivāsessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambentī nivāsentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambenti nivāsessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.16: yā anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambentī nivāseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
